entities.summary: Assitan Keïta, popularly known as Mamani Keïta is a singer and musician from Mali. "Mamani" literally means "grandmother". Mamani Keita was a composers & musicians from Bamako (b. 1965-10-20, Bamako). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis. Its legacy: Created musical compositions of lasting significance.
